notes.title: Japanese version save file load error fixed
notes.notes:
We have made fixes to the Japanese version of Neptunia Rebirth2. The Japanese version of the game had a problem loading save files. With this update you can now load saves.
*This update does not affect or is applicable to the English or Chinese version of the game.

In order to make your old saves please do the following.
NOTE: You must go into Rebirth 2 and create a new save file. This will allow Steam to create the new Save directory.

1. Navigate to the .exe directory of Rebirth 2
Path: C: / Program Files (x86) / Steam / steamapps / common / Neptunia Rebirth2

2. Select all .sav, .savslot files, and the "Neptune2" configuration file
NOTE: Each save has two files tied to it. One .sav & One .savslot file. The “Neptune2” file should be type "configuration settings" or a .ini file.

3. Copy all Select Files

4. Navigate to new Save Directory (You need to make a new save for this directory to exist)
Path: C: / Program Files (x86) / Steam / userdata / [User ID] / 351710 / remote
NOTE: The [User ID] should be the most recently modified folder, unless you are using multiple accounts often.

5. Paste the files into the new directory

6. Restart Steam

7. Launch Rebirth 2

8. Load desired Save

notes.title: 5.18.2018 Update
notes.notes:
Calling all players of Gamindustri! We have some great news! We have updated the build today with the following fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where playing in-game movies would cause the game to crash.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and help with this issue. If there are other problems, please continue using the forums to search for possible fixes or submit the issues to our PC Support form [url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]here[/url] to give us feedback directly!

[/list]

本件につきましてご了承いただき誠にありがとうございます。

[/list]

謝謝大家關於這個問題的幫助與耐心. 如果遇到任何別的問題的話,請在遊戲的網路論尋找解答或是在[url=http://ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php]PC論壇[/url]上直接報告任何問題或反應!

notes.title: Update for the last patch!
notes.notes:
Sorry guys, it seems like the last patch has caused crash issues for some people!

We've reverted to the last previous version of the game until we can suss out the dungeon issues. As always, thanks for your patience!
